subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving retained D7 users for {Brand} the way Candy Crush Saga and Royal Match buy installs while holding day-7 quality. The one point worth repeating: we optimize MAFO to the retained D7 user and read it back through a server-to-server retention postback via your MMP with the cohort date, so you pay against validated retained players at an eCPA of $9 on the retained user, never the raw install. If it helps, I can pull the cohort-level D7 read by genre and platform. Worth a short look?
angle: warm bump, restate retained-D7 postback proof
illustrative_flags: eCPA on the retained user of $9 (MobUpps, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN gaming_casual: references prior in S1; restates single proof (retained D7 optimization + S2S retention postback via MMP with cohort date and level-progression signal); one illustrative figure (eCPA $9 on the retained user); brands only from brand_candidates (Candy Crush Saga, Royal Match); soft CTA, exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; native English; no 'X, not Y' (phrased positively as 'never the raw install').
